Ao Tanaka.note: Tanaka gives Japan midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Ao Tanaka.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Japan来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Ayase Ueda.note: Ueda has already shaped Japan's tournament with goals against Tunisia and service for teammates. Watch how quickly his next action follows the first touch.
Ayase Ueda.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经同时给Japan带来终结和传球。防守者不能只防他的一种选择。

Ayumu Seko.note: Seko is defensive cover for Japan's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Ayumu Seko.noteZh: 他是Japan在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Daichi Kamada.note: Kamada has already punished Netherlands and Tunisia for Japan. The watch point is how little room he needs once the chance is alive.
Daichi Kamada.noteZh: 他让Japan拥有一个必须被惦记的得分点。每个松散球都可能突然变重。

Daizen Maeda.note: Maeda is on the scoresheet for Japan, with his goal coming against Sweden. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Daizen Maeda.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Hiroki Ito.summary: Hiroki Ito is a Japan left-footed centre-back at Bayern Munich who gives the national team passing balance, recovery cover, and aerial defending.
Hiroki Ito.note: Ito gives Japan one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Hiroki Ito.noteZh: 他是Japan无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Junnosuke Suzuki.note: Suzuki gives Japan cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Junnosuke Suzuki.noteZh: 他是Japan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Junya Ito.note: Itō's World Cup has already included a goal against Tunisia. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Junya Ito.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Kaishu Sano.note: Sano has already given Japan a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Kaishu Sano.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Japan贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Keisuke Goto.note: Gotō is attacking depth for Japan. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Keisuke Goto.noteZh: 他是Japan前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Keisuke Osako.note: Ōsako sits behind the starter for Japan, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Keisuke Osako.noteZh: 他给Japan保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Keito Nakamura.note: Nakamura has shown both sides of the attacking job for Japan. One action can pull the defender, and the next one can decide the chance.
Keito Nakamura.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Japan贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Kento Shiogai.note: Shiogai gives Japan a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Kento Shiogai.noteZh: 他是Japan在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Koki Ogawa.summary: Koki Ogawa is a Japan centre-forward at NEC Nijmegen who gives the national team penalty-box finishing, aerial presence, and striker depth.
Koki Ogawa.note: Ogawa has supplied one of Japan's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Koki Ogawa.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Japan创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Kou Itakura.note: Itakura has already created a goal for Japan in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Kou Itakura.noteZh: 他已经参与了Japan的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Ritsu Doan.note: Dōan has supplied one of Japan's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Ritsu Doan.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Japan创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Shogo Taniguchi.note: Taniguchi gives Japan defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Shogo Taniguchi.noteZh: 他是Japan艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Shuto Machino.note: Machino is attacking depth for Japan. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Shuto Machino.noteZh: 他是Japan前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Takefusa Kubo.note: Kubo has one tournament assist in the bank for Japan. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Takefusa Kubo.noteZh: 他已经帮Japan制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Takehiro Tomiyasu.note: Tomiyasu is defensive rotation for Japan. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Takehiro Tomiyasu.noteZh: 他是Japan艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Tomoki Hayakawa.note: Hayakawa is goalkeeper cover for Japan. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Tomoki Hayakawa.noteZh: 他是Japan门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Tsuyoshi Watanabe.note: Watanabe is defensive cover for Japan's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Tsuyoshi Watanabe.noteZh: 他是Japan在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Yuito Suzuki.note: Suzuki is midfield insurance for Japan. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Yuito Suzuki.noteZh: 他给Japan一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Yukinari Sugawara.note: Sugawara is defensive cover for Japan's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Yukinari Sugawara.noteZh: 他是Japan在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Yuto Nagatomo.note: Nagatomo gives Japan another trusted body for the awkward minutes. One clean decision can keep the match from tilting.
Yuto Nagatomo.noteZh: 他是Japan赛事深度的一部分。压力下还能让简单选择出现，这就是这张卡的意义。

Zion Suzuki.note: Suzuki has carried the keeper minutes for Japan. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Zion Suzuki.noteZh: 他是Japan防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。
